author: DistroTube
description:
How to install Arch Linux via the command line installation process. I will use UEFI, btrfs, zram, and install a popular Wayland compositor (niri).

NOTE:
This video was re-uploaded in order to correct a major mistake (by omission) made in the first version of this video. I did not run the command to create the 'fstab' file. Oops!

REFERENCED:
► https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Installation_guide
